content_of_post_to_comment: The companies struggling most with AI keep assigning it to the person with the most technical knowledge. Wrong owner. AI changes how the business operates. That makes it a leadership responsibility with technical support—not a technical project waiting for executive approval.
comment: There's a subtle trap here: executives can own the AI strategy while still measuring success by old metrics. If AI changes how work gets done, the definition of good performance may need to change too.
